notes.title: April Playtest Schedule
notes.content:
We have some open playtests coming down the tracks for April! 

Our playtests are currently time limited and not available outside of the times below so make sure you are all aboard when the train leaves the station! Our playtests are not region locked so feel free to join as many as you like but expect latency issues for distant servers.

Note: You will be able to launch the game, but outside of these times playing will be restricted by a password so we can test the game. When the playtest starts just restart your client and the password will be lifted!

[b]Saturday April 5th & Sunday April 6th[/b]
Our first multi-day playtest, you will be able to keep your isotope and battle pass progression across each session. We are also introducing improvements to the Class 3 early game to make it easier to advance through the train. Join us for 3 hours in each region.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934770/c0948edf32d925180812bfada2452ba53ea47356.png[/img]

[b]Friday-Sunday April 18th - April 20th[/b]
The Easter Bunny has brought longer playtests and Asian Servers! We will move from 3 to 5 hour long playtests to test extended duration gameplay and progression. Join the Discord and check our release notes for more info on all the cool things coming to the build![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934770/ee2158481a03e3e02f4e6ced091feb1b01f00f7e.png[/img]

[b]Friday-Sunday May 2nd - May 4th[/b]
Join us for our Feature Playtest in early May! This will be a big milestone to test the fun of progression and extraction and help us inform polish and improvements on the feature. Your feedback is essential to making Enginefall a game you want to play for years to come!
[b]Timings TBD[/b]

As always if you have any questions or technical issues, please join our discord server for more info!
